The path-derived module namespace uses tools.agentrail.agentrail.* while source imports use agentrail.*, preventing closure. Although the receipt discloses a related hyphenated-package under-count defect, its dynamic dead_modules=499 headline remains an unqualified dead-module count and does not satisfy the work-unit requirement to trace every declared entry point and CI step. The receipt and AUD-0032 probe output hashes were unchanged by rerun.
